notes.title: Bug fix update
notes.content:
Today’s update is full of bug fixes!

- Game no longer crashes at trainers after the first one
- Game no longer freezes on European devices (the camera got locked onto a cave)
- No more trail glitching across the screen in forest special training
- Fixed the font in battle defaulting to a basic one
- Fixed mountains collision near the police duck
- Fixed Swamp health
- Fixed purple duck near the Grand Dojo

notes.title: BUG FIXES GALORE
notes.content:
- Fixed an evil bug that deleted your save data
- Fixed some other slightly less evil bugs

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed bug that caused save data to be deleted (sorry to all who lost their data!)
- Fixed bug that stopped Farm Power training working

Found a bug in the game? The best way to tell us about it is on our Discord server https://discord.gg/MAPEkNB4sC

notes.title: The Arena is now open!
notes.content: We are excited to announce the opening of the new fighting arena in the city! Now you can battle your friends' ducks and take on strangers to become the top battling duck in the world

notes.title: Spanish and German languages added!
notes.content: Another month, another two new languages added. Spanish and German speakers rejoice, you can now play Duck Life battle in your own language!

notes.title: French and Thai languages added
notes.content:
Do you speak French or Thai? Good news! You can now play Duck Life Battle in your own language. 

More languages are coming soon, keep watching this space!

notes.title: Steam leaderboards added
notes.content: We just added Steam leaderboards to the training games in the Grand Dojo. Get your score in quick so you can celebrate being top of the leaderboard before they start filling up!
